guidance.prompt_note_if_actor_incomplete: You need your high-speed CFexpress card from the kitchen island before you can begin cutting today's footage. Move toward the Open Kitchen.
You are in the Open Kitchen. Inspect the stainless-steel island to pick up the CFexpress card.
You have your card. Head through the living lounge and take the teak stairs up to the 2F Design Studio.
You are in the Design Studio. Inspect the video editing station to load the card and review today's footage.
It's past midnight. The smell of roasted barley tea drifts from the Open Kitchen where Ren is prepping. Head toward the Open Kitchen.
You are in the Open Kitchen with Ren. Ren pours a steaming mug of roasted barley tea across the counter. Accept the tea with a quiet gesture.
Holding the warm ceramic mug, speak with Ren about the pressure of editing today's footage and your fatigue.
After the quiet moment with Ren, head down the basement stairs to the soundproof B1 Diary Room.
You are alone in the soundproof B1 Diary Room. Rest on the interview stool or record your honest reflections before the two-way mirror.
